h: How to Get the Best Snaps
p: Let's be honest, the photos are the whole point, so a little planning goes a long way. Charge your phone before you set off and clear a bit of storage, as you'll take far more pictures than you think. Group shots work best if one person plays photographer for each zone, then you swap, so nobody ends up missing from every picture.

Early in the day is usually calmer, giving you more time with the big-name figures before the crowds build. If someone's after a particular celebrity, head there first, as popular figures can draw a little queue. Props and interactive bits are dotted around some zones, so don't be shy about joining in. The more you ham it up, the better the photos.

Most visitors get round in an hour or two, so it slots neatly into a seaside day without taking it over. The museum is in a cluster of attractions close to the Tower, so it pairs easily with the Tower's own experiences, and SEA LIFE Blackpool is nearby if the kids want to swap celebrities for sharks. Combination tickets can work out better value if you're planning several attractions, so look at the options before you buy.
Once you're done, North Pier and the beach are a short stroll away for some fresh air, a paddle or a bag of chips on the sea wall.
